role: combined layout and material homepage direction
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one complete high-fidelity desktop homepage comp combining an approved layout and an approved material direction.

CRITICAL INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the Ferromark WORKING SPECIMEN page, the EDIT TARGET and the SOLE LAYOUT AUTHORITY. The identifying feature is a narrow LEFT MARGIN COLUMN with a small topic heading and short introductory prose beside EVERY content story, separated by a broad gutter from the larger right reading/evidence column. This is the selected layout. Preserve that distinctive structure faithfully across the entire body, not just one section.
Image 2 is the Ferromark PAPER & PEWTER page, a MATERIAL / PALETTE / TEXTURE / TABLE-CRAFT reference ONLY. Its layout was not selected. Transfer its warm ivory stock, refined paper fibers, matte pewter, oxide, light behavior and table finish onto Image 1. DO NOT import Image 2's full-width body arrangement, equal editorial columns or prose/ledger side-by-side layout.

Goal: a complete, convincing overall feeling of the selected small-left-introduction editorial layout AND the warm, slightly browner, rusty/beige material direction together. This is a refined precision-engineering Rust library: warm, light, technical, durable, carefully made. All sections stay light theme.

LOCKED COMPOSITION:
- Keep Image 1's header and airy two-part hero: product introduction and actions left, the actual meaningful single mechanical instrument right. Preserve its object shape and complete presentation, satin metal, oxide and real contact shadow. Keep the small existing logo in the header/footer.
- Below the hero use the narrow left introductory margin for EACH story. It occupies roughly 16–18% of the content width, a generous gutter roughly 5–6%, then the main content roughly 76–78%. Small topic/introduction type has clear contrast and line spacing, not illegible microtype. Intro text stays quieter and smaller than main content. The main headings, paragraphs, demos, tables and chart all begin at the same main-column x-coordinate roughly one quarter of the content frame from the left. Do not allow a table or title to slide back to the outer left margin.
- Preserve Image 1's full story order, pair of worked-example specimens, main prose, evidence and table sequence, notes and closing install command. Large vertical whitespace between stories; no cramped chart captions or column gutters.
- Use the exact warm paper base from Image 2 across the reading page, with fine tactile fiber grain, never dirty or distressed. Color roles: paper #F4F0E6, inlay #FBFAF6, pewter #DCDDD6, ink #29362F, muted #5C655B, accent #88492F.
- A SINGLE substantial matte pewter measurement spread creates one calm material change. It spans the page ground behind BOTH the small left measurement introduction AND the main benchmark figure; retain the exact same two-column geometry through this surface. Its illumination changes very gently over the physical micrograin, not a decorative CSS-looking gradient cloud. Use clean straight material boundaries, generous inset space, a very light metal value and readable dark text. Keep other stories on warm paper. Do not add little isolated texture cards or many patchy backgrounds.
- Open airy data tables belong to this composition. Keep functional hairlines light, human-language labels left aligned, numbers right/decimal aligned, units clear, source notes separated. Use subtle paper-white fields for code specimens. Preserve the selected layout's quiet vertical margin cue if useful, but add no decorative horizontal story separators. No generic rounded card system or heavy borders.
- Materials enrich the whole composition without adding large body illustrations. The one substantial object remains in the hero. No extra pictures, no fake social proof, dark bands, neon, grunge, bolt framing, mockup boards or browser chrome.

Preserve all actual semantics and authoritative data below. Incidental generated glyph or syntax errors in the reference are not the authority. All visible text is US English. Output ONE complete full-page homepage, uncropped, at roughly the same portrait proportions and desktop width as Image 1. Prioritize the narrow introductory left column and the selected warm material feeling equally.

Margin topics: Rendering — From Markdown to structured HTML and metadata. Output policy — Correct handling for real documents. Measurements — Real performance with real conditions. Compatibility — Recognize content without granting permission. The document — More than paragraphs. Get started — Use it your way.

Exact authoritative product copy and data:
Header: Ferromark. Overview. Start with Rust. Rendering. Benchmarks. GitHub. The Ferramenta family.
Hero title: Ferromark.
Purpose headline: Markdown, ready for your pipeline.
Hero description: Turn Markdown into HTML and the metadata around it. A focused Rust engine for the documents that get complicated.
Primary action: Start with Rust. Secondary action: Node.js guide.

Working example title: See what a document becomes.
Markdown input is the heading "# Release notes", followed by the list "- Clear structure" and "- Useful metadata". The rendered output must show the heading Release notes and exactly those two list items.

Opening story: Correctness is a contract.
A Markdown engine has to earn trust on the awkward document: a nested list, a reference that moves, a table with real content, or a footnote added at the last minute. Ferromark starts with CommonMark and GFM, then makes the publishing features explicit.
Specification profiles turn off publishing extras so that conformance can be checked on its own terms. Optional heading IDs, front matter and footnotes belong to a documented output contract.
A small publishing ledger: Front matter — extracted as raw text; Heading IDs — configurable output; Footnotes — document references and notes; Rendering hooks — your application decides.

Measured figure title: Speed, with the conditions attached.
Fresh throughput relative to Ferromark v2, higher is faster.
Exact rows: Ferromark v2 1.00×; Ferromark v1 0.48×; pulldown-cmark 0.38×; md4c 0.29×; Bun native 0.17×.
Provenance: September 21, 2026. Apple M1 Pro. Revision 39b1f0b7. 50 documents with equivalent HTML across five engines, from a frozen 57-document corpus. Other cases remain diagnostics. Fresh and reuse are separate lifecycles. These recorded figures do not promise every workload.
Link: Read the measurements and exact flags.

Policy reference title: Recognition is not permission.
The engine can recognize raw HTML without granting permission to emit it.
Table columns: API | Default | For untrusted Markdown.
Exact rows: Rust | Raw HTML passthrough | Enable sanitize.
Node.js | Escaped HTML and filtered URL schemes | Keep renderPolicy: 'untrusted'.
Footnote: Custom hooks and highlighter HTML are written verbatim. They must escape untrusted values themselves.
Link: Choose your rendering policy.

Publishing note: The document, beyond paragraphs.
Extract front matter as raw text; the application interprets YAML or TOML. Configure heading IDs and footnotes. Keep templates, translation, routing and syntax highlighting outside the renderer.
Closing: Build the pipeline that fits.
Start with the Rust crate, or use the native engine through Node.js. Pair Ferromark with Ferriki for syntax highlighting; neither engine requires the other.
Install: cargo add ferromark.
Footer: Ferromark. Part of Ferramenta. GitHub. Imprint. Privacy.
